_what: The shapes by which source sends Trillion-wide work (work no signed-in person owns: everyone's rules and setup records, payment and event signatures, service secrets and OAuth clients, the service relay, client health) into one person's store: a call that reaches the operator account's PersonStore. Read by test/service-work-counts.mjs for test/no-service-work-in-person-store.test.mjs. A pattern is matched across line breaks within one statement; comments are not read. A new way to reach an account's store for service work is one more pattern here. Indirect forms count too: an account id list or a constant that names the OPERATOR_ACCOUNT_ID setting, and a DATA row whose setting names it (generic code resolves the account the row names, so the row is the choice). A pattern with its own `extensions` reads only those files. Patterns are only added, never narrowed (test/no-service-work-in-person-store.test.mjs).
